name: TM7 Mary Berry Style Lemon Meringue Pie - Revised Meringue
ingredients: 160 g caster sugar, for TM7 meringue (reduced from original 225 g)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 160°C fan / 180°C conventional. Prepare a 23 cm loose-bottomed flan tin. Note: TM7 meringue uses 160 g sugar rather than original 225 g, based on Thermomix guidance of maximum 40 g sugar per egg white.
Add 225 g plain flour and 175 g cold unsalted butter. Mix 10 sec / speed 6.
Add 45 g icing sugar, 1 large egg and 15 g cold water. Mix 15 sec / speed 4.

Bring pastry together by hand, roll to 3 mm, line tin and chill 30 minutes. Trim and prick base. Line with baking paper and baking beans; bake 15 minutes, remove beans and paper and bake another 5–10 minutes until dry and lightly golden. Reduce oven to 150°C fan / 170°C conventional.
Clean bowl. Add zest of 6 lemons, 180 g lemon juice, 65 g cornflour and 450 g water. Mix 15 sec / speed 4.
Cook 10 min / 100°C / speed 3 until thick. Extend by 1–2 minutes if needed.
Allow mixture to cool to approximately 80°C. Separately whisk 6 egg yolks and 250 g caster sugar.
Gradually introduce yolk mixture while mixing on speed 3 over 30 seconds, using the TM7 lid safely; alternatively stop blades and add in small portions.
Cook 5 min / 90°C / speed 3 until thick like custard. Pour into baked pastry.

Clean and completely dry bowl and butterfly whisk. Ensure no yolk or grease remains. Fit butterfly and add 4 egg whites. Whisk 2 min / 37°C / speed 3.5, then stop and inspect. Whites should be foamy and hold soft peaks; if still liquid, whisk 30 seconds more. Thermomix's published meringue guidance uses 37°C.

TM7-friendly sugar method: weigh 160 g caster sugar separately. With the machine stopped, add 80 g sugar to the soft-peaked whites, then whisk 1 min / speed 3. Add remaining 80 g with blades stopped and whisk 1–2 min / speed 3, checking every 30 seconds. Stop once glossy and firm. Do not exceed the TM7 lid's safe operating instructions; do not try to pour sugar through a closed lid.

Add 6 g cornflour and fold gently by hand after removing the butterfly, or mix very briefly 5 sec / speed 2.5. Stop when combined. If meringue is loose, do not keep whisking for several more minutes; investigate bowl cleanliness or egg contamination instead.
Spread meringue over warm filling, sealing to pastry edges. Create peaks. Bake at 150°C fan for 15–20 minutes until golden and set. Cool 1–2 hours before cutting.
